national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Continuation of Credit Guarantee Funds for PM Mudra and Stand-Up India Schemes
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) for five years up to March 31, 2031, with a ₹5,000 crore outlay to support loans worth ₹12.60 lakh crore.

The Stand-Up India Scheme has been extended up to March 31, 2031, with a credit guarantee corpus of ₹4,111 crore to provide ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore loans to an additional 2.5 lakh SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs.
The Cabinet also sanctioned an 8.5 km extension of the Aqua Line Metro Rail Corridor from Noida Sector-51 to Greater Noida Sector-04, adding five elevated stations.

national_news.title: Russia and Ukraine Reach Agreement in Principle on Prisoner Exchange in Abu Dhabi Talks
bullets: Russia and Ukraine agreed in principle to a major prisoner-of-war (POW) exchange following US-mediated negotiations held in Abu Dhabi.
The diplomatic discussions were facilitated by US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, representing one of the largest potential humanitarian prisoner releases of the conflict.
Ukrainian leadership advocated for direct European participation in subsequent negotiations regarding security guarantees and continental defense infrastructure.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu to Confer Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu conferred the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan Awards 2025-26, organized by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs in New Delhi.
The 10th edition's theme is 'Swachhata Ki Nayi Pehel- Badhayein Haath, Karein Safai Saath', covering over 4,000 cities compared to 73 urban local bodies during its inception in 2016.
Urban Local Bodies were evaluated across 43 indicators spanning 10 assessment areas, including waste segregation, urban riverfront sanitation, and worker welfare.

national_news.title: Government Invites Fresh Applications Under Extended PLI Scheme 2.0 for Medical Devices
bullets: The Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers invited fresh applications under the Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Promoting Domestic Manufacturing of Medical Devices (PLI-MD 2.0).
The scheme has been extended up to 2035-36 with a total financial outlay of approximately ₹2,700 crore.
Revised guidelines remove the minimum sales threshold, lower minimum investment criteria, and allow companies three years to establish facilities across four target medical device segments.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves Building Bylaws 2026 to Boost Green Urbanization
bullets: The Bihar State Cabinet has approved the Bihar Building Bylaws 2026 to promote eco-friendly urban development, planned satellite townships, and green cities across the state.
Key provisions of the new bylaws include green building standards, mandatory rooftop solar installations, water conservation measures, and an increased Floor Area Ratio (FAR).

The framework is set to accelerate major regional infrastructure projects, including the Sonepur City Development Plan (comprising a greenfield airport, industrial corridor, and logistics hub) and the Gangajal City project.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Develop ₹1.21 Lakh Crore Hajipur-Gaya Industrial Corridor and 5-District Defence Corridor
bullets: The Bihar government announced the development of an industrial corridor spanning 1,650 acres between Hajipur and Gaya, starting at Rajapakar in Vaishali, with an estimated investment proposal of ₹1.21 lakh crore.

A dedicated Defence Corridor will be established across five districts: Munger, Kaimur, Jamui, Banka, and Arwal to manufacture weapons including fighter jet parts, drones, artillery guns, and small arms.

The state currently operates an Ordnance Factory in Nalanda producing the Bi-Modular Charge System (BMCS) for artillery, while Munger retains its historical gun manufacturing identity dating back to 1760.

bihar_news.title: Patna Municipal Corporation Lists ₹200-Crore Municipal Bonds on NSE
bullets: Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) officially listed its ₹200-crore municipal bond on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), becoming the first civic body in Bihar to access market-based urban financing.
The state announced plans to expand Patna's Marine Drive from 26 km to 126 km with a proposed investment of ₹30,000 crore under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
The government highlighted urban development plans including 12 greenfield satellite townships like Pataliputra Township and financial support of up to ₹98,000 for 3-kW rooftop solar installations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches Ganga Water Metro Service in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister launched a catamaran water metro service on the Ganga river operating between Digha Ghat and Gandhi Ghat in Patna, with plans for extension to Kangan Ghat.
The service utilizes a 50-seater hybrid electric-powered vessel designed to reduce pollution and provide an alternative transit route to the congested Ashok Rajpath.
The state tourism department initiative sets the single adult fare at ₹50, offering fast and shore charging facilities at the terminal ghats.
